description:
Job Title: Ab Initio Developer 
 Primary Skills: Experience using Ab-Initio GDE, BRE, Continuous Flow and EME required.
 Location: DE
 Duration: 12 months
 • 5 + years experience in Ab-Initio coding of medium to large scale ETL applications
• Experience using Ab-Initio GDE, BRE, Continuous Flow and EME required.
• Experience in UNIX operating environment is required
• Experience in Java/J2EE development a plus
• Mainframe experience is a plus
• Exposure to DB2 is a plus
• Ability to communicate at all levels of management and with customers
• Demonstrated skills both written and oral are required
• Experience in the development of financial applications is a strong plus
• Bachelors degree in Computer Science or related field of study or equivalent relevant experience in mainframe programming

Preferred Skills:
• Experience with an online system with high availability credit card auth system, high throughput and quick response times is preferred
• Functional experience with change management, implementation planning and release management
• Experience in code management and version methodologies with experience with a leading code management
• Financial industry experience and credit card or payment systems experience in large scale/high volume industry is preferred
• Good oral and written communication skills
• Must work well either independently or as part of a team with a strong desire to excel
• Experience with developing and managing interfaces with various Credit card associations preferred.
• Good business knowledge of end to end Credit Card Authorizations processing preferred
